items.name: back-link
items.title: BackLink
items.description: One quiet way back. Muted, small, arrow included.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid. One button per day, min/max bounds.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontal scroll-snap row of tall images.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Bar, line, area, pie, donut. One series, SVG + data table.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: DatePicker
items.description: Read-only input plus popover calendar. Clear, Today.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: Two DatePickers, one range. End-before-start is an error.

items.name: equalizer-bars
items.title: EqualizerBars
items.description: Four bars that say: something is playing.

items.name: favorite-accordion
items.title: FavoriteAccordion
items.description: A favorite that opens into label/value detail rows.

items.name: file-grid-cell
items.title: FileGridCell
items.description: One file in a grid: art, filename, meta.

items.name: filter-pill
items.title: FilterPill
items.description: A filter you can tap. Inactive is outline, active is ink.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: The bottom of the page. Small, muted, done.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: A named group of photos: heading, count, three-across grid.

items.name: header
items.title: Header
items.description: Wordmark left, mood control right. The top of every page.

items.name: lede
items.title: Lede
items.description: The standfirst that sets the page. Big, quiet, one thought.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: One photo, big, on near-black. Prev, next, count, close.

items.name: list-row
items.title: ListRow
items.description: A full-width row: title, description, and an optional meta. Inline (two columns without meta, three with it) or stacked (title + meta on top, description below). The index's workhorse.

items.name: live-badge
items.title: LIVEBadge
items.description: A red dot and the word LIVE. Small, loud, honest about its contrast.

items.name: live-hero
items.title: LiveHero
items.description: Headline + sub. The live moment, up top.

items.name: live-pulse-dot
items.title: LivePulseDot
items.description: An 8px dot and its expanding ring. Live, at a glance.

items.name: logo-card
items.title: LogoCard
items.description: A big centered mark. The logo gets the whole card.

items.name: logo-cell
items.title: LogoCell
items.description: A centered logo in a card cell. Quiet, even, 160 wide.

items.name: media-card
items.title: MediaCard
items.description: A full-bleed moment: status bar up top, caption at the bottom.

items.name: menu-bottom-sheet
items.title: MenuBottomSheet
items.description: The menu, as a sheet: grab bar, sections, rows, active dot.

items.name: menu-pill
items.title: MenuPill
items.description: The floating pill that opens the menu sheet.

items.name: mood-button
items.title: MoodButton
items.description: One dot. Five moods. Tap to cycle.

items.name: next-footer
items.title: NextFooter
items.description: The way onward. A hairline, then the next row.

items.name: page-title
items.title: PageTitle
items.description: A page's name + its meta. Smaller than a hero, firmer than a heading.

items.name: photo-card
items.title: PhotoCard
items.description: A gradient card with an orb and a label. Four moods of the same card.

items.name: photo-tile
items.title: PhotoTile
items.description: Square art, a name, a category. The smallest photo unit.

items.name: playlist-row
items.title: PlaylistRow
items.description: Thumb + title + meta, with a track list that unfolds.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: A 3px bar. The number lives in the text next to it.

items.name: qa-accordion
items.title: QAAccordion
items.description: Question up top, answer underneath. One at a time, plain words.

items.name: reaction-button
items.title: ReactionButton
items.description: A circle to tap, a label, a caption. Voted gets an underline.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Type to filter a list. Arrows move, Enter follows, Escape clears.

items.name: section-title
items.title: SectionTitle
items.description: A section's name, an optional note, and a hairline underneath.

items.name: standfirst
items.title: Standfirst
items.description: Body copy that opens a page. One paragraph, room to breathe.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A metric, a big number, a unit. Nothing else.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: StatusDot
items.description: Inline status: a dot and a word. For sentences, not pills.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: StatusPill
items.description: A status with a dot. Text carries it; the dot echoes it.

items.name: status-row
items.title: StatusRow
items.description: Label + value, one line. Status at a glance.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A small uppercase label. Quiet metadata, hairline border.

items.name: text-link
items.title: TextLink
items.description: The call to action. Bold ink, a 2px underline, nothing else.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: Trigger plus time listbox. 12-hour labels, HH:MM value.

items.name: toggle-tabs
items.title: ToggleTabs
items.description: Two or more views, one row. Active is ink + underline.

items.name: view-all
items.title: ViewAll
items.description: A full-width pill that opens the whole list.
